SELECT tm.model_id AS modelId, tm.manufacturer AS manufacturer, tm.name AS name, tm.transport_category AS transportCategory, tm.lap_time AS lapTime, tm.top_speed AS topSpeed, ot.owned_id AS ownedId, ot.image_url AS imageUrl FROM transport_model tm
INNER JOIN ( SELECT model_id, MIN(owned_id) AS owned_id FROM owned_transport WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND acquired_yn = 'Y' GROUP BY model_id ) selected_owned ON selected_owned.model_id = tm.model_id
INNER JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = selected_owned.owned_id
transport_category = #{category}
AND lap_time IS NOT NULL
AND top_speed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lap_time ASC
ORDER BY top_speed DESC
